title: Agent Input Contract
description: Specialist agent input object per AIDD §2.1. Every agent invocation receives this structure.

goal_context.description: Founder's original goal text plus orchestrator's classification/decomposition summary

scoped_data_access_token.description: Time-limited JWT granting access only to data sources in the agent's registry scope. Never a standing credential.

task_description.description: The specific sub-task this agent invocation must complete

tenant_id.description: Enforced at every downstream data call. Agent must reject processing if data returns rows outside this tenant.

prior_context.description: Prior AgentRun IDs in the same goal's task graph determined relevant by the orchestrator
